name: WeatherBond TPO Membrane 60-mil
description: High-performance 60-mil TPO single-ply roofing membrane with heat-weldable seams. Industry-leading reflectivity reduces cooling loads. Available in white, gray, and tan.

name: EPDM Sure-Seal Membrane 60-mil
description: Premium 60-mil EPDM membrane in black. Exceptional weathering resistance and elongation properties. Ideal for large-area commercial and industrial roofs.

name: FleeceBACK TPO Membrane 80-mil
description: 80-mil fleece-backed TPO membrane for adhered applications. The fleece backing allows direct-to-deck adhesion eliminating the need for separate insulation fasteners on re-roofing projects.

name: CavGard Polyiso Insulation
description: Polyisocyanurate foam insulation board with glass-fiber mats on both faces. Class A fire rated. Available in 2-in, 2.5-in, and 3-in thicknesses. R-value per inch: 6.5.

name: SecurTAPE Seam Tape 6-in
description: 6-inch wide pressure-sensitive seam tape for Carlisle TPO systems. Bonds edge-of-membrane to adjacent sheet without a heat welder. For detail work and T-joint covers.

name: Sure-Grip Insulation Fasteners
description: #12 x 3-in self-drilling insulation fastener with 3-in steel plate for securing insulation boards to structural steel and wood decks. Meets FM 1-90 wind uplift.

name: FlashBand Self-Adhesive Flashing
description: Self-adhesive flashing membrane for use at penetrations, curbs, and perimeter edges. Aggressive adhesive for positive bond in temperatures above 40°F. Available in 6-in and 9-in widths.

name: Coated Metal Drip Edge
description: 24-gauge Galvalume drip edge pre-coated with Kynar 500 PVDF fluoropolymer coating. 10-ft lengths. Coordinates with Carlisle TPO and EPDM systems. Available in 12 standard colors.

name: RUSS Single-Ply System Kit
description: Roof Uplift Safety System kit for large commercial projects. Includes membrane anchor bars, seam plates, and all fasteners required to meet FM Global 1-90 to 1-210 uplift ratings. Each kit covers 10 squares.

name: EPDM Bonding Adhesive
description: Solvent-based contact adhesive for fully adhered EPDM roofing systems. Neoprene-based formula with excellent open time. Apply to both membrane and substrate; allow open time before mating surfaces. 5-gallon pail covers approximately 2 squares.
